description: This file defines a template class 'JsonRpcInterface' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, which provides an interface for sending JSON-RPC requests, handling responses, and processing notifications over WebSocket connections. It includes methods for managing asynchronous responses, setting notification handlers, and processing incoming messages.

classes.name: JsonRpcInterface
classes.description: A template class providing an interface for JSON-RPC communication over WebSockets, including request sending, response handling, and notification processing.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request and waits for the response, returning success status.

methods.name: setNotificationHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback function to handle incoming notifications.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming message, dispatching it as a response or notification.

methods.name: getAsyncResponse
methods.description: Waits for an asynchronous response with a timeout, processes the response if available.

methods.name: createFutureResponse
methods.description: Creates and stores a promise for an expected response identified by request ID.

methods.name: removePromise
methods.description: Removes the stored promise associated with a request ID.

methods.name: isRequestProcessingOngoing
methods.description: Checks if a request with a given ID is currently being processed.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles an incoming response message, setting the promise value.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes the response string into a JsonRpc::Response object and extracts success or error info.
